# hivelocity_vps_events (Data Source)

Lists the event log of a VPS instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_vps_events" "app" {
  device_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) Device ID of the instance.

### Read-Only

- `events` (List of Object) Events, as returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `event_id` (String)
- `level` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `type` (String)
